Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first search execution (Step 1), the WebSurfer agent retrieved a search result snippet from the Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy (IEP) that incorrectly stated James Fieser received his B.A. from "Bates College." This initial hallucination or retrieval error by the WebSurfer set the wrong premise for the entire conversation. Although later searches (in subsequent steps) correctly identified "Berea College" in multiple authoritative sources (Wikipedia, IEP, DBpedia), the Planner failed to recognize that the very first source presented was erroneous and should have been discarded immediately. The Planner incorrectly accepted the Bates College claim as a valid lead to investigate further, leading to unnecessary confusion and redundant search cycles trying to resolve a conflict that was resolved by the correct data appearing later in the conversation. The root cause of the wrong solution path was the initial error in the WebSurfer's first step.
